ruleDefinitions.name: Uncommon Outbound Kerberos Connection - Security
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects uncommon outbound network activity via Kerberos default port indicating possible lateral movement or first stage PrivEsc via delegation.
 Note: Unmapped fields: DestPort, Application

sequences.query: (event_id = 5156 AND DestPort = 88) AND  NOT (((Application = RGX("^\\\\device\\\\harddiskvolume") OR Application = RGX("^C\\:")) AND Application = RGX("\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\lsass\\\.exe$"))) AND  NOT (((Application = RGX("^\\\\device\\\\harddiskvolume") OR Application = RGX("^C\\:")) AND (Application = RGX("\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Google\\\\Chrome\\\\Application\\\\chrome\\\.exe$") OR Application = RGX("\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Google\\\\Chrome\\\\Application\\\\chrome\\\.exe$"))) OR ((Application = RGX("^\\\\device\\\\harddiskvolume") OR Application = RGX("^C\\:")) AND (Application = RGX("\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Mozilla\\ Firefox\\\\firefox\\\.exe$") OR Application = RGX("\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Mozilla\\ Firefox\\\\firefox\\\.exe$"))) OR Application = RGX("\\\\tomcat\\\\bin\\\\tomcat8\\\.exe$"))
